title: Stock-in
workorderHelp: Only work orders in progress or completed can be selected; the product and batch come from the work order
qtyHelp: Submitted and stocked quantities of a work order cannot exceed its completed quantity in total
confirmComplete: Confirm stock-in "{code}"? The quantity is added to the work order's stocked quantity.
confirmCancel: Cancel stock-in "{code}"? This cannot be undone.
